segments.an7.5:1.3: Saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hirīdhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ.
segments.an7.5:2.3: Sutadhanañca cāgo ca, paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ.
segments.an7.5:3.1: “Yassa ete dhanā atthi, itthiyā purisassa vā;
segments.an7.5:3.3: Adaliddoti taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.
